description: Defines classes and structures related to user-defined types, particularly ClassType and ClassAttribute, for TorchScript in PyTorch. Includes methods for managing class attributes, methods, constants, and hooks.

classes.name: ClassType
classes.description: Represents a user-defined class in TorchScript, managing attributes, methods, constants, hooks, and properties, with capabilities for refinement and subtype checking.

classes.name: ClassAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute of a class, including its name, type, and kind (buffer, parameter, or regular).

classes.name: AttributeKind
classes.description: Enumeration of attribute kinds: BUFFER, PARAMETER, REGULAR_ATTRIBUTE.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Represents a property of a class with a name, getter, and setter functions.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ClassType instance with an optional qualified name, compilation unit, module flag, documentation string, and unresolved attributes.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this ClassType is equal to another Type based on name and compilation unit.

methods.name: str
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ClassType.

methods.name: repr_str
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation including the compilation unit.

methods.name: methods
methods.description: Returns the list of methods associated with the class.

methods.name: findAttribute
methods.description: Finds an attribute by name and returns its type or nullptr if not found.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the type of an attribute by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: numAttributes
methods.description: Returns the number of attributes.

methods.name: getAttribute(size_t)
methods.description: Returns the type of an attribute by its slot index.

methods.name: getAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the name of an attribute by slot index.

methods.name: checkNotExist
methods.description: Checks that an attribute with the given name does not exist.

methods.name: findAttributeSlot
methods.description: Finds the slot index of an attribute by name.

methods.name: getAttributeSlot
methods.description: Returns the slot index of an attribute by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: hasAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an attribute exists by name.

methods.name: isUnresolvedClassAttribute
methods.description: Checks if an attribute is unresolved.

methods.name: containedTypes
methods.description: Returns the contained types of the class.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds a new attribute with name, type, and flags for parameter/buffer.

methods.name: unsafeRemoveAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute by name (internal use).

methods.name: unsafeChangeAttributeType
methods.description: Changes the type of an attribute (internal use).

methods.name: addOrCheckAttribute
methods.description: Adds or verifies an attribute with type compatibility.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property by name.

methods.name: addProperty
methods.description: Adds a property with getter and setter functions.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Returns all properties.

methods.name: hasConstant
methods.description: Checks if a constant exists by name.

methods.name: addConstant
methods.description: Adds a constant with name and value.

methods.name: findConstantSlot
methods.description: Finds the slot index of a constant by name.

methods.name: getConstantSlot
methods.description: Returns the slot index of a constant by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: getConstantName
methods.description: Returns the name of a constant by slot index.

methods.name: getConstant
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a constant by name or slot.

methods.name: findConstant
methods.description: Finds a constant by name.

methods.name: numConstants
methods.description: Returns the number of constants.

methods.name: constantNames
methods.description: Returns list of constant names.

methods.name: constantValues
methods.description: Returns list of constant values.

methods.name: unsafeRemoveConstant
methods.description: Removes a constant by name (internal use).

methods.name: createWithContained
methods.description: Creates a new ClassType with contained types, copying attributes and methods.

methods.name: is_module
methods.description: Checks if the class is a module.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Returns the list of attributes.

methods.name: addForwardPreHook
methods.description: Adds a pre-forward hook function.

methods.name: addForwardHook
methods.description: Adds a forward hook function.

methods.name: findForwardPreHook
methods.description: Finds a pre-forward hook by name.

methods.name: findForwardHook
methods.description: Finds a forward hook by name.

methods.name: getForwardHooks
methods.description: Returns all forward hooks.

methods.name: getForwardPreHooks
methods.description: Returns all pre-forward hooks.

methods.name: checkForwardPreHookSchema
methods.description: Validates schema of a pre-forward hook.

methods.name: checkForwardHookSchema
methods.description: Validates schema of a forward hook.

methods.name: addMethod
methods.description: Adds a method to the class.

methods.name: findMethod
methods.description: Finds a method by name.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves a method by name.

methods.name: findHook
methods.description: Finds a hook by name.

methods.name: getHook
methods.description: Retrieves a hook by name.

methods.name: hasMethod
methods.description: Checks if a method exists.

methods.name: findStaticMethod
methods.description: Finds a static method by name.

methods.name: addStaticMethod
methods.description: Adds a static method.

methods.name: compilation_unit
methods.description: Returns the associated CompilationUnit.

methods.name: refine
methods.description: Creates a refined version of the class with subtype slot types.

methods.name: isSubtypeOfExt
methods.description: Checks subtype relation with extended criteria.
